TrapWin Limiter @VERSION@ - macOS (VST3 + AU)
=============================================

Thank you for buying TrapWin Limiter!

REQUIREMENTS
  macOS 10.15 or newer, Intel or Apple Silicon (native), and a VST3 or
  Audio Unit host (Logic Pro, GarageBand, Ableton Live, FL Studio, Reaper ...).

OPTION A - INSTALLER (recommended)
  1. Close your DAW.
  2. Double-click TrapWin_Limiter_v@VERSION@_macOS.pkg and follow the steps.
     You can choose VST3 and/or Audio Unit (AU - needed for Logic Pro and GarageBand).
  3. Open your DAW. Logic Pro scans new Audio Units automatically; in other
     hosts rescan plugins.

OPTION B - MANUAL INSTALL
  From the "Manual Install" folder copy
     TrapLimit.vst3       to  /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/
     TrapLimit.component  to  /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/
  (In Finder: Go > Go to Folder... and paste the path.) Then restart your DAW.

Find the plugin as "TrapWin Limiter" (vendor: TrapWin).

UNINSTALL
  Delete TrapLimit.vst3 from /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/ and
  TrapLimit.component from /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/
  Your own presets are in ~/.trapvst/limiter/presets

User guide: "TrapWin Limiter - Manual.pdf"   License terms: EULA.txt

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
CESKY
  A) Dvakrat klikni na TrapWin_Limiter_v@VERSION@_macOS.pkg a projdi instalaci
     (VST3 a/nebo AU pro Logic Pro a GarageBand).
  B) Nebo rucne ze slozky "Manual Install": TrapLimit.vst3 do
     /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/, TrapLimit.component do
     /Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/
  Pak restartuj DAW. Plugin najdes jako "TrapWin Limiter".
